budget: one response per flow per model; maximum 3000 successful responses, 9000 HTTP attempts
common_prompt: Impute missing packet lengths in a single bidirectional network flow. The input array is chronological. Positive and negative denote opposite directions, magnitude is IP length in bytes (clipped at 1600). Each null is one missing packet. Return JSON only: an object with key values containing one nonzero signed integer in [-1600,1600] per null, in left-to-right order. Preserve the number of missing slots.
format_repair: none; no format retries or truth-assisted repair
http_retry: at most 3 attempts for 429/500/502/503/504 and transport exceptions
invalid: count all hidden slots as misses and fill zero for downstream evaluation
note: Models use identical LOW thinking level, not necessarily identical internal compute; no temperature set.
primary: mean of the six frozen downstream classifier accuracies (equal classifier weights)
prompt_optimization: not performed in this batch; cohort B untouched
setting: Exploratory teacher/prompt selection from the historical test split
ties: pooled exact signed-length hit rate; then fewer invalid responses; then provider name
